newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Tribunal to investigate blood board over infection.
newsitem.headline: Tribunal to investigate blood board over infection.

text.p: A tribunal of inquiry into the Blood Transfusion Services Board is being set up following the death of a woman who received an infected blood product from them, Irish health minister Michael Noonan said on Tuesday.
"This is a matter of urgent public importance and it would be my hope that the tribunal will be able to conclude its deliberations at the earliest possible date," he said.
Noonan said the tribunal would inquire into the circumstances surrounding the infection of hundreds of women who were infected by the blood product anti-D, made by the Blood Board.
The terms of reference of the tribunal and its membership are to be finalised within a week.
